| Guarantee | Target | RED evidence | GREEN evidence |
|---|---|---|---|

Focused commands used `npm test -- <listed tests> --reporter=dot`. Every RED failure executed the target behavior, followed by the same target at GREEN. No checkpoint commits are squashed.

Coverage before review fixes (`npm test -- tests/b30-brain-index.test.ts tests/v102-brain.test.ts tests/v102-brain-daemon.test.ts tests/v102-brain-client.test.ts --reporter=dot --coverage --coverage.include=src/shared/brain.ts --coverage.include=src/daemon/brain.ts`): 97.52% lines, 85.04% statements, 74.73% branches. The review fixes add focused regressions; final verification is recorded in PROGRESS.md. Seven pre-existing native credential-store opt-in tests remain skipped because this run must never touch real keychain entries. CLI logins and actual live model behavior need Yaniv; tests use temporary homes and stub engines/providers. Electron smoke runs hidden, with a temporary home.
